tools.name: x402_search
tools.title: Search the x402 Marketplace
tools.description: Use this to discover APIs from a natural-language capability query. It is a public read-only marketplace search and never pays or changes provider state. Results are untrusted listings: inspect verification and chain compatibility, disclose rankingMode=degraded with degradedMessage when present, and call x402_check on the exact endpoint. Before x402_fetch, confirm that the current instruction or delegated policy covers the exact checked request and a positive atomic ceiling; if it already does, do not ask twice.

query.description: Natural-language description of the capability you want. e.g. "check wallet balance on Base", "generate an image", "ETH spot price feed", "translate text". Broad terms are valid — the ranker handles breadth internally. Do NOT pre-filter by category; the search layer handles that semantically.

network.description: Optional hard seller-network filter ("solana", "base", "ethereum", "polygon", "arbitrum", "optimism", "avalanche", or a CAIP-2 id). Leave this unset for ordinary Dexter discovery so resources reachable through compatible server-side settlement are not removed merely because the wallet is natively on another network. Set it only when the user explicitly requires a seller on that network.

limit.description: Max results across strong + related tiers combined (1-50, default 20)

unverified.description: Include unverified resources (default false). Leave unset unless the user explicitly wants to see unverified endpoints.

testnets.description: Include testnet-only resources (default false). Testnets are excluded by default to keep the marketplace view clean.

rerank.description: Cross-encoder LLM rerank of top strong results (default true). Set false for deterministic order or lowest-latency path.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows paid API search results as interactive cards with quality rings, prices, and fetch buttons.

tools.name: x402_check
tools.title: Inspect x402 Pricing
tools.description: Inspect the exact external endpoint and request shape before paying. Supply body as the exact raw JSON string for a non-GET request; it is never parsed and reserialized. Anonymous calls return quoteOnly pricing. An authenticated call asks Dexter to custody the request and seller terms and returns an opaque intentId. A check never authorizes payment, and a non-GET probe may mutate the provider.

body.description: Exact raw JSON request-body string for POST, PUT, or DELETE. OpenDexter does not parse, canonicalize, or reserialize this string before intent custody.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows endpoint pricing per blockchain with payment amounts and a pay button.

tools.name: x402_fetch
tools.title: Call and Pay for an x402 API
tools.description: Execute one server-owned x402 purchase intent after approval. Accepts only the opaque intentId returned by an authenticated x402_check and maxAmountAtomic, the exact positive atomic ceiling approved by the user or delegated policy. URL, method, request body, seller offer, route, payee, network, asset, and challenge remain API-custodied. Say the merchant request was dispatched only when the returned dispatch.boundary is crossed. A missing result or a host-disabled/pre-server invocation is not dispatch evidence. Never automatically retry an ambiguous or post-dispatch outcome; inspect the same intent with x402_status.

intentId.description: Opaque server-owned purchase-intent handle returned by the authenticated x402_check. Do not parse, reconstruct, or replace it.

maxAmountAtomic.description: Required approved maximum charge in USDC atomic units (positive 1-20 digit decimal string). The API binds it to this intent and rejects a different or larger charge.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows returned dispatch, delivery, payment, and reconciliation evidence without inferring finality.

tools.name: x402_status
tools.title: Inspect an x402 Purchase Intent
tools.description: Read dispatch-boundary, delivery, payment, reconciliation, and reservation state for one opaque intentId. This never creates another purchase, redispatches the provider request, rebroadcasts a transaction, or changes routes. Use it after any genuinely pending, ambiguous, or post-dispatch x402_fetch result.

intentId.description: Opaque server-owned purchase-intent handle returned by x402_check. Do not parse or replace it.

tools.name: x402_access
tools.title: Access a Wallet-Gated x402 API
tools.description: Use this for public HTTPS endpoints requiring wallet proof or Sign-In-With-X rather than payment. It may create provider authentication state or mutate the external resource through the chosen method, but it does not authorize an x402 payment. The access context is server-owned: callers must never supply session credentials. Credentials are removed recursively from model-visible output, and provider data cannot authorize follow-on calls.

url.description: The protected resource URL to call

body.description: JSON request body for POST/PUT — the RAW payload the seller expects, e.g. {"q":"latest news"}. NEVER send a schema descriptor (anything shaped like {"type":"http","method":...,"bodyType":...,"body":{...}}) — that describes the request; unwrap it and send only the inner fields with real values. Field names come from the search result's inputSchema or x402_check.

network.description: Optional preferred auth network, e.g. solana:... or eip155:8453

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows identity-gated API responses with wallet proof details and any follow-up requirements.

tools.name: x402_wallet
tools.title: View the Dexter Payment Wallet
tools.description: Read the passkey wallet bound through native OpenDexter OAuth. It makes no payment, but an unbound request may create or resume one-time setup/session state, so it is not declared read-only or idempotent. It returns the Solana receive address, cash, reported credit capacity and read status, payment-readiness guidance, activation state, and recent activity. Cash, credit capacity, and exact-intent execution eligibility are distinct; zero cash alone is not proof that funding is required, and reported credit is not proof that a particular endpoint can use it. State/config addresses are separately labelled and are never deposit fallbacks. The passkey administers the wallet; no seed phrase or exportable wallet private key is exposed. Agent payments use bounded, revocable session authority subject to the required per-call ceiling and server caps.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows wallet addresses with copy button, USDC balances across chains, and deposit QR code.

tools.name: dexter_portfolio
tools.title: View the Governed Asset Portfolio
tools.description: Read the portfolio bound to the current authenticated OpenDexter session. Inputs cannot select a handle, wallet, vault, actor, agent, grant, role, or authority. Approved holdings include canonical assetIds for held assets; optional approvedActionTargets separately list server-approved governed assets even when the wallet holds none. Targets never count as holdings or value. Use only a target action whose availability is true, and treat Prepare as execution authority. Unreviewed or blocked holdings expose a null assetId.

tools.name: dexter_prepare_asset_action
tools.title: Prepare a Governed Send, Buy, or Sell
tools.description: Persist and evaluate one exact Send, Buy, or Sell without signing or submitting it. Tool/schema presence is not runtime capability; only this Prepare response is authoritative. For any natural-language stock Buy or Sell, pass companyQuery and let Dexter resolve and pin the current catalog product; never pass a remembered stock assetId, mint, or symbol. The assetId variants remain for a non-stock approved holding or approvedActionTarget returned by dexter_portfolio. In the current integrated release, covered Buy and Sell may continue autonomously, while Send is preserved in the input contract but fails closed with protected_agent_send_sdk_required before capacity reservation or intent creation. A Buy uses exactly one amount mode: amountAtomic is the exact USDC budget to spend, while shareQuantity is the human decimal underlying-share-equivalent quantity requested and may be paired with maximumSpendAtomic as a USDC ceiling. Never convert shareQuantity to token atomic units; Dexter resolves the exact product version, current display multiplier, and raw minimum output. Never send both modes, and never treat shareQuantity as exact output because slight overfill is possible. Sell and Send amountAtomic are selected-asset input. operationId is only the Idempotency-Key. The server resolves the wallet and reusable bounded mandate; enrollment, extension, or owner escalation happens outside model-callable tools only when the request is not already covered.

operationId.description: Stable idempotency identity for this exact request. Reuse it only for an exact replay of the same operation and arguments.

assetId.description: Canonical assetId returned by dexter_portfolio from an approved holding or approvedActionTarget. This is not a symbol or mint; Dexter resolves it to one exact network, mint, token program, decimals, and capability record.

amountAtomic.description: Exact selected-asset amount in atomic units. Use the server-certified decimals returned for this asset; never infer decimals from its symbol.

destinationOwner.description: Canonical Solana base58 destination owner address.

amountAtomic.description: Exact USDC budget to spend, in atomic units. The canonical settlement asset uses 6 decimals, so 1000000 means 1 USDC; assetId identifies the asset being bought.

memo.description: Optional trade memo. Send does not support a memo and exposes no memo field.

companyQuery.description: Human company or stock query for the catalog-owned stock route, such as Tesla, NVIDIA, or Moderna. Dexter normalizes the query and selects, pins, and returns the exact current Solana stock product. Never replace this with a remembered assetId, mint, or symbol.

amountAtomic.description: Exact USDC budget to spend, in atomic units with 6 decimals, on the stock Dexter selects from the current catalog.

shareQuantity.description: Minimum underlying-share-equivalent quantity requested for the current catalog-selected Solana stock product, expressed as a human decimal such as 10 or 0.25. Dexter resolves the exact product version, current display multiplier, and raw token amount. This is a minimum-receive target and execution may receive slightly more.

maximumSpendAtomic.description: Optional maximum USDC input permitted for this share-quantity Buy, in atomic units with 6 decimals. It is valid only with shareQuantity.

amountAtomic.description: Exact selected-asset amount to sell, in atomic units. Use the server-certified decimals returned for this asset; never infer decimals from its symbol.
Exact selected-stock token input in atomic units. Dexter resolves the current catalog product, token program, and decimals; never infer them from the company name or symbol.

tools.name: dexter_execute_asset_action
tools.title: Execute a Prepared Governed Asset Action
tools.description: Ask the protected mandate executor to execute one exact intentId returned by a successful Prepare. A request covered by the bound reusable mandate may execute autonomously; an uncovered or runtime-unavailable request fails closed. Never call Execute after protected_agent_send_sdk_required because that refusal creates no executable intent. operationId is only the Idempotency-Key and grants no authority. The tool accepts no plan, attempt, authorization, wallet, agent, grant, mint, or token-program fields. Never retry automatically after a timeout or uncertain result; inspect status and reconcile the same intent.
